tei:div.tei:p: 361)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: lha mo'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbyig thob bzhugs so: na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: (Dakini secret letter here) dbang gi lha mo sgrub pa yi: skal ldan skyes bu las can rnams: thog mar sgo gsum sgrib dag cing: byin rlabs dngos grub thob pa'i phyir: dad mos gdung shugs drag po yis: brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba gdab: e ma ho: gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba dang: snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags pa pad dkar 'chang: dbang gi bka' babs klu sgrub snying po'i zhabs: gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol: don brgyud byin rlabs 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: grub pa mchog brnyes rig 'dzin padma 'byung: gsang sngags snod ldan ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: ka la siddhi zhi ba rdo rje mtsho: gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol: don brgyud byin rlabs 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: dbang gi lha mo bcom ldan rig byed ma: khams gsum dbang bsgyur dngos grub 'byung gnas mchog: dbang drag thabs kyis 'gro rnams rjes su 'dzin: padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor 362)lha tshogs la: gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol: don brgyud byin rlabs 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: rim gnyis zab mo'i lam mchog mthar phyin nas: lhun grub gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog: de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis: don brgyun dgongs pa'i byin rlabs thob par nges: the tshom med do skal ldan nyams su longs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu hya: brda thim: ཿ ces pa'ang yid bzhin nor bu'i bzhed skong du mtsho rgyal gsung sprul bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o/ dge'o/
